title: Chop by note, then join
thisBuild: Chop by note: on the Sample sheet, Chop to pads has a new By note button. It cuts wherever the note changes or the same note is played again, and each slice moves to C as it lands on a pad, so it plays its real note on the keys.
Join the slices: once two or more slices of a sound are on pads, the same spot has Join. It glues them back into one new sound in pad order, with their new pitch, trims and effects.
Re-pitch now hears sounds as short as a twentieth of a second, noisy attacks and fast fades too.
watch: Sample a hummed or played melody, tap By note, then Chop to pads. Do the cuts land between the notes?
Play the slices on the keys, move a few to other pads, then Join. Does the new sound play them in pad order?
limits: By note looks at the first 30 seconds and makes at most 32 slices.
Chords and busy loops have no single note, so their slices stay as they are.
Some tuned kicks now read as a note, so Re-pitch can move them. Undo puts them back.
